lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's nine? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 9? Nope!

lines.text: A calculator shows three. One key adds one. The other key doubles.
lines.caption: A calculator shows 3. One key adds 1. The other key doubles.

lines.text: What's the fewest presses to make ninety?
lines.caption: What's the fewest presses to make 90?

lines.text: Work backwards from ninety! Even? Cut it in half. Odd? Take one away.
lines.caption: Work backwards from 90! Even? Cut it in half. Odd? Take one away.

lines.text: Ninety, forty-five, forty-four, twenty-two, eleven, ten, five, four.
Half of four is two, too small. So take one away: three!
lines.caption: Half of 4 is 2, too small. So take one away: 3!

lines.text: Count the arrows, not the numbers. That's eight presses!
lines.caption: Count the arrows, not the numbers. That's 8 presses!

lines.text: Nine was the trap. It counts the numbers in the chain.
lines.caption: 9 was the trap. It counts the numbers in the chain.

lines.text: Did you get eight? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 8? Tell me below!
